questions.question: Two coins tossed. P(exactly one head)?
questions.explanation: Sample space: {HH,HT,TH,TT}. Exactly one H: {HT,TH} = 2. P = 2/4 = 1/2.

questions.question: P(getting sum = 8) when two dice are rolled?
A weather station records: sunny 150 days, rainy 80, cloudy 135 in a year (365 days). P(rainy tomorrow)?
A bag has 6 red and 4 blue balls. One drawn, not replaced. If first is red, P(second is also red)?
questions.explanation: After one red removed: 5 red remain, 9 total. P(second red) = 5/9.

questions.question: In a class of 30 students, 18 like Math, 12 like Science, 6 like both. P(student likes Math but not Science)?
Coin tossed 3 times. P(all three heads)?
questions.explanation: Total outcomes = 2³ = 8. Only HHH is all heads = 1. P = 1/8.

questions.question: P(drawing a card that is both red AND a face card) from a 52-card deck?
questions.explanation: Red face cards = J,Q,K of Hearts + J,Q,K of Diamonds = 6 cards. P = 6/52 = 3/26.

questions.question: A spinner with sectors 1–10. P(prime OR even)?
P(getting at least one 6) when two dice are rolled?
questions.explanation: P(no 6 on either die) = 5/6 × 5/6 = 25/36. P(at least one 6) = 1 − 25/36 = 11/36.

questions.question: Cards 1–10. Drawn twice WITH replacement. P(both cards > 7)?
questions.explanation: Cards > 7: 8,9,10 = 3 cards. P(one card > 7) = 3/10. With replacement: 3/10 × 3/10 = 9/100.

questions.question: If P(A) = 1/3 and P(B) = 1/4 and A,B are mutually exclusive, P(A or B) = ?
questions.explanation: Mutually exclusive events: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) = 1/3 + 1/4 = 4/12 + 3/12 = 7/12.

questions.question: A factory makes items. 5% are defective. If 200 items are checked, how many expected defective?
